notes: 1. A special device must be used to execute the NIST test suite, except for the STM32L4P/Q, STM32H7A3/7B3, and STM32H72x/73x.
2. The bit 6 of RNG_CR enables or disables the bypass of post‑processing/conditioning logic. This bit must be enabled to run the NIST SP800‑90B test suite.
3. "Yes" indicates when the configuration values are part of an official NIST SP800-90B certificate. Links to these certificates can be found in Table 4.
